about: Verdicts of the jsoncons evaluation on the corpora of test/include/support/schema_corpus.hpp, recorded while the SDK used jsoncons (up to version 0.3.0). A verdict string is the compile outcome ('o' compiles; 'i', 'd', 'r', 'p' a SchemaError category) followed, when the schema compiles, by '1' or '0' per value.
